title: Entryway step-ladder visuals and screen anchors for Quickstart landing
creator: Maya Chen
description: Design a fresh, modular visual system for the Quickstart landing that surfaces a clear entry path for new engineers. Deliver a hero illustration, a progressive step-ladder diagram (3 progressive steps), and a set of annotated screen anchors for product screenshots. Visuals must be responsive, accessible (contrast and focus states), and easily reusable across docs and marketing micro-sites.
design_notes: Goal: reduce cognitive load on first-run flow by showing ‘what to expect’ in 3 clear steps
Prefer modular illustration assets (SVG component layers) to support runtime color/theming
Include WCAG AA contrast for callouts and 48px tap target guidance for mobile screenshots
Create two hero density options: full-bleed illustrative hero and compact card hero for product pages
Avoid existing Quickstart hero metaphors (no staircase motif). Introduce a ‘step-ladder’ motif using anchored glyphs and progress halo
Assets should map to Console routes: onboarding-quickstart, create-api-key, run-sample-request
tasks: Sketch 6 exploratory compositions (entryway, directional flow, anchored steps)
Define color tokens and accessible variants (dark/light)
Generate componentized SVGs with labeled layers for engineering handoff
Create 3 annotated product screenshot templates with overlays and copy callouts
Ship final assets + export guidelines to the docs repo and design system
acceptance_criteria: Hero illustration: desktop and mobile variants exported as componentized SVGs
Step-ladder diagram: clearly labeled 3-step flow with supporting microcopy and CTA placement guidance
Screenshot anchors: 3 templates with 1200x720, 900x600, 420x800 exports and overlay spec
All text/foreground colors meet WCAG AA on background tokens
Dev handoff includes Figma file, export instructions, and PR to docs repo with example usage
Stakeholder sign-off from PM and at least one engineering reviewer
